name: select
description: Picks one option from a list in a popover, for 4 to about 15 choices; for 2 or 3 use radio buttons, for long lists use a combobox, which filters as the user types. Compose the parts inside Select: SelectLabel, SelectTrigger (shows the value or placeholder), SelectDescription, SelectError (renders only while the value is invalid) and SelectPopover holding SelectItems, all exported from the select file. Each SelectItem's id is the value onChange reports and the form submits.

props.name: children
props.description: SelectLabel, SelectTrigger, optional SelectDescription and SelectError, then SelectPopover.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name; the form submits the chosen item's id.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value: the chosen item's id; pair with onChange.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the newly chosen item's id.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown in the trigger until something is chosen.

props.name: isRequired
props.description: Requires a choice before the form submits.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Prevents opening and dims the field.

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Marks the value invalid from outside, e.g. after a server error.

props.name: disabledKeys
props.description: Ids of items that show but can't be chosen; or set isDisabled on a SelectItem.
